sources.author: DH-Robotics
sources.use: Cross-check topology only; older speed and tolerance values are not merged into the newer drawing

interface.scope: One moving jaw end face, without-brake drawing; not an arm flange
interface.coordinate_definition: u is horizontal and v vertical in the published end view; origin at the M3 axis
interface.other_locator: Published end view shows a relieved/elongated locator on the opposite side of M3

parts_per_finger: Mounting shoe located against the moving jaw end face
Rigid offset carrier with two separate pad seats
finger_concept.fastening_concept: One M3 screw per jaw plus locating features; screw and pin selections remain open
finger_concept.passive_pad_conformity: In the lateral closing direction; material, travel and stiffness remain unselected
finger_concept.schematic: Side view shows the nearer finger only; both fingers are retained in the concept, with no upper pressing motion

drawing_constraints_not_acceptance.load_basis: Catalogue static load and moment annotations; not assigned contact forces or verified combined-load limits
drawing_constraints_not_acceptance.cable_scope: Gripper electrical lead only; not Ampere HV wire, the prior 56 mm line cable or a selected moving-cable route

source_boundaries: Direct downloads from DH returned HTTP 403; public manufacturer-authored mirrors were acquired instead
Official integrated manual 3.2 was discoverable, but its image-only pages were not locally acquired or visually inspected
Precicon PDF metadata dates do not prove a current manufacturing revision
Neobotix speed is 0.2 s, Precicon and live model table are 0.3 s; no process time is derived
Locator tolerance changed between these documents; the older +0.01/+0.03 values are not combined with the newer 0/+0.02
14 mm is the jaw face dimension, not a two-bolt pitch; 2-M3 counts both jaws
Brake state, power-loss retention and product lifecycle remain unconfirmed for hardware adoption

Mating pin fit, screw engagement and torque, adapter and robot-side interface
